build_hifigan_manifest: run the script to build a HiFi-GAN manifest JSON from a fairseq TSV and HuBERT KM file
run_main: run the main function to generate JSON manifest lines from TSV and KM input files
create_manifest_from_tsv_km: create a HiFi-GAN manifest by combining a fairseq TSV file with HuBERT clustering codes
review_main: review the main function that validates TSV and KM file lengths and outputs JSON manifest lines
summarize_main: summarize the main function that reads TSV and KM files, validates wav durations, and prints JSON
